text:
maria (Support): @dan :wave: customer hitting intermittent 503s & extreme tail latency. They gave request_id: abc123-zz-9876 and approximate time 2026-03-16T15:02:10Z. Can someone pull server-side traces/logs? Repro curl attached.

 dan (SRE): which region/cluster? edge or private infra?

 maria (Support): hosted-us-west-2, route /v1/generate, user reported during a burst at ~15:02 UTC. Here's the curl they tried:

 ```bash
 curl -v "https://api.redwood.run/v1/generate" \
   -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \
   -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
   -d '{"model":"rw-large", "input":"hello", "request_metadata":{"request_id":"abc123-zz-9876"}}'
 ```

 dan (SRE): thanks. quick KQL to search hot logs:

 `request_id:"abc123-zz-9876" OR message:abc123-zz-9876`

 Search window: 15:00-15:10 UTC. Note: hot tier retention is 14 days for full request logs. After that we need archive retrieval (see log-archiver-bot).

 log-archiver-bot: To retrieve from cold archive run:

 ```text
 POST https://internal-logs.redwood/api/v1/archives/search
 Auth: Bearer <internal-token>
 Body: {"request_id":"abc123-zz-9876","start":"2026-03-16T14:55:00Z","end":"2026-03-16T15:15:00Z"}
 ```

 log-archiver-bot: If results are in cold storage this will create an async job; ETA ~10-20m.

 sara (Backend): I ran the KQL against edge logs and found matching lines — there are upstream 502s from edge-proxy to runtime at 15:02:12.

 ```
 [2026-03-16T15:02:12Z] request_id=abc123-zz-9876 level=error upstream=runtime-03/10.2.9.8 error="connection reset by peer" latency_ms=2134
 ```

 sara (Backend): Can you also ask customer to add header `x-rw-debug: 1` and resend if they can repro. That will surface more debug headers in logs. Also please collect a debug bundle (browser devtools HAR or edge logs) and attach to the ticket.

 maria (Support): forwarding to customer now. Also uploading support debug bundle id dbg-20260316-555 to the case.

 dan (SRE): I can pull the runtime container logs for that window. If we need full traces from cold archive, @log-archiver-bot please kick off the job and ping here with archive job id.

 log-archiver-bot: archive job created job_id=arch-9845 status=pending. ETA 12m. Use `GET /api/v1/archives/arch-9845` to poll.

 maria (Support): thanks all. Next steps: wait for archive job if customer needs deeper traces; if archive shows runtime OOMs or panics we'll escalate to eng-runtime. I'll mark ticket as investigating and link these findings. :thumbsup:

 sara (Backend): one more note — please include the client's IP and x-rw-session header if available. Those help correlate edge -> runtime connections.

 dan (SRE): pulled runtime logs — saw socket close on server side concurrent with a GC spike. Pasting snippet:

 ```
 [2026-03-16T15:02:11Z] runtime=rw-runtime-12 pid=7421 level=warn GC_pause_ms=412 socket_close reason=OOM? mem_rss_mb=6523
 ```

 maria (Support): added all logs/snippets to ticket #1234. Will update customer with ETA from archive job.

 sara (Backend): if archive returns nothing, we can provide the snippets and suggest customer add `x-rw-debug` for repro. If they can reproduce reliably, we'll ask for a curl with that header so we get full trace.

 maria (Support): noted. closing loop here once archive job id is complete or we have repro. :white_check_mark:
